description: This file contains helper classes and functions for interacting with a shell environment, specifically for embedded device testing and MCU boot management. It includes classes for executing shell commands, waiting for prompts, filtering output, and parsing MCU boot area information.

classes.name: Shell
classes.description: Helper class providing methods to interact with a device shell, including command execution, prompt waiting, and output filtering.

classes.name: ShellMCUbootArea
classes.description: Data class representing an MCU boot area with attributes like name, version, image size, and status flags.

classes.name: ShellMCUbootCommandParsed
classes.description: Data class for storing parsed output of an mcuboot shell command, containing a list of ShellMCUbootArea instances.

methods.name: Shell.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the Shell object with a device, prompt, and optional timeout.

methods.name: Shell.wait_for_prompt
methods.description: Waits for the device prompt by sending newline commands periodically until detected or timeout.

methods.name: Shell.exec_command
methods.description: Executes a shell command on the device, waits for output and prompt, and returns the response lines.

methods.name: Shell.get_filtered_output
methods.description: Filters out prompt and debug/ info/ warning/ error lines from command output.

methods.name: ShellMCUbootArea.from_kwargs
methods.description: Creates an instance of ShellMCUbootArea from keyword arguments, filtering only valid fields.

methods.name: ShellMCUbootCommandParsed.create_from_cmd_output
methods.description: Parses the output of an mcuboot shell command to create a ShellMCUbootCommandParsed instance with areas.
